style: STYLE RULES: Soft, modern pixel art exactly in the style of the reference images (the meadow scene and Adam): small soft pixel blocks, gentle painterly shading with light from the upper left, natural colours, smooth flat areas with little texture noise, and NO dark outlines: shapes are separated only by colour and light. Top-down three-quarter view like the reference scene. Each subject stands alone, with NO cast shadow, ground patch, grass or scenery under or around it. The references show the style and scale only: draw new subjects, do not copy or edit the references. BACKGROUND: one flat solid magenta colour (#FF00FF) everywhere around the subjects, with no glow or texture on it. Leave wide clear magenta space between separate subjects; subjects never touch or overlap. No text, letters, numbers, labels, borders or frames.

jobs.title: The finished ark
jobs.prompt: One single big sprite filling most of the image width: Noah’s ark, finished, standing on the ground on a few low wooden blocks, seen from the top-down three-quarter view of the reference scene, its long side facing the viewer and its bow to the right. A huge, plain, box-like wooden vessel of long horizontal planks of warm brown gopher wood sealed with dark pitch in the seams, a gently curved hull with a flat bottom, three decks shown by two faint lines of planks along the side, a low pitched roof of planks running along the top with a narrow row of small window openings just under the roof, and one big closed square door in the middle of the side near the ground with a wooden ramp leading up to it. No sails, no masts, no figures, no animals, no water, no ground, no grass.
